finalText:
Migration's done. Twelve files still had `db.query` calls and now use `db.execute({ sql, params })` instead: `cohort.js`, `sla.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`, `returnService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `couponService.js`, `teamService.js`, `refund.js`, `supplier.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, and `shipment.js`.

Left untouched, on purpose: `cache.query` calls (a different thing entirely) and `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (vendored code, gets overwritten on upgrade anyway). The verify script confirms it — every call site moved, nothing else did.
